Date: 2021-12-03 WHAT IS CLAIMED IS:
1. A vascular graft (1) comprising a flexible substrate (3), which can assume an unrolled configuration, in which the substrate (3) extends along a main extension plane, and a rolled-up configuration, in which a first surface (11) of the substrate (3) on a first side of the substrate (3) is facing radially inward and a second surface of the substrate (3) on a second side of the substrate (3) is facing radially outward, at least one pressure sensing device (5), which is arranged on the first side of the substrate (3) and comprises a first electrode (17), a second electrode (21), and a piezoelectric element (19) arranged between the first electrode (17) and the second electrode (21), and
at least one velocity sensing device (7), which is arranged on the first side of the substrate (3) and comprises a first electrode (17), a second electrode (21), and a piezoelectric element (19) arranged between the first electrode (17) and the second electrode (21).
2. The vascular graft (1) according to the previous claim, wherein the substrate (3) comprises in the unrolled configuration a rectangular shape and in the rolled-up configuration a cylindrical shape, preferably the shape of a hollow cylinder.
3. The vascular graft (1) according to any of the previous claims, wherein the substrate (3) comprises Polydimethylsiloxane, PDMS.
4. The vascular graft (1) according to any of the previous claims, wherein each pressure sensing device (5) is formed of a layer stack comprising multiple layers, wherein, when the substrate (3) is in the unrolled configuration, each layer extends in parallel to the main extension plane, wherein a first layer of the multiple layers comprises the first electrode (17), a second layer of the multiple layers comprises the piezoelectric element (19), and a third layer of the multiple layers comprises the second electrode (21), the second layer being arranged between the first and the third layers.
5. The vascular graft (1) according to claim 4, wherein a fourth layer of the layer stack comprises a flexible layer (23) arranged between the substrate (3) and the first electrode (17).
6. The vascular graft (1) according to any of the previous claims, wherein each pressure sensing device (5) comprises in the unrolled configuration a rectangular shape, the rectangular shape comprises preferably an extension along a first direction (13) parallel to the main extension plane of 0.2 to 1.5 mm, preferably 1 mm, and an extension along a second direction (15) parallel to the main extension plane and perpendicular to the first direction (13) of 0.2 to 1 mm, preferably 0.5 mm.
7. The vascular graft (1) according to any of the previous claims, wherein each pressure sensing device (5) is adapted to detect pressures from o to 40 kPa.
8. The vascular graft (1) according to any of the previous claims, wherein each velocity sensing device (7) comprises a cantilever, which comprises the piezoelectric element (19) of the respective velocity sensing device (7).
9. The vascular graft (1) according to claim 8, wherein, in the unrolled configuration, the cantilever extends from a supported end in parallel to the main extension plane towards a free end such that, in the rolled-up configuration, the free end is positioned radially inward of a portion of a wall defining a recess (27) formed in the substrate (3), wherein the recess (27) is open towards the first side of the substrate (3).
10. The vascular graft (1) according to any of the previous claims, wherein each velocity sensing device (7) is formed of a layer stack comprising multiple layers, wherein, when the substrate (3) is in the unrolled configuration, each layer extends in parallel to the main extension plane, wherein a first layer of the multiple layers comprises the first electrode (17), a second layer of the multiple layers comprises the piezoelectric element (19), and a third layer of the multiple layers comprises the second electrode (21), the second layer being arranged between the first and the third layers.
11. The vascular graft (1) according to claim 10, wherein a fourth layer of the layer stack comprises a flexible layer (23) arranged between the substrate (3) and the first electrode (17).
12. The vascular graft (1) according to any of claims 9 to 11, wherein the recess (27) comprises in the unrolled configuration a shape of a rectangular cuboid, the rectangular cuboid comprises preferably an extension along a first direction (13) parallel to the main extension plane of 0.5 to 1.5 mm, preferably 1 mm, an extension along a second direction (15) parallel to the main extension plane and perpendicular to the first direction (13) of 0.5 to 1 mm, preferably o.8 mm, and an extension along a third direction (25) perpendicular to the main extension plane of 0.2 to 1 mm, preferably 0.5 mm.
13. The vascular graft (1) according to any of the previous claims, wherein each velocity sensing device (7) comprises in the unrolled configuration a square shape, the square shape comprises preferably an extension along a first direction (13) parallel to the main extension plane of 0.2 to 1.5 mm, preferably 0.5 mm, and an extension along a second direction (15) parallel to the main extension plane and perpendicular to the first direction (13) of 0.2 to 1.5 mm, preferably 0.5 mm.
14. The vascular graft (1), according to any of the previous claims, wherein each velocity sensing device (7) is adapted to detect flow velocities from o to 1000 ml/min.
15. The vascular graft (1) according to any of the previous claims, wherein the piezoelectric element (19) of the pressure sensing device (5) comprises polyvinylidene difluoride, PVDF, and/or the piezoelectric element (19) of the velocity sensing device (7) comprises polyvinylidene difluoride, PVDF.
16. The vascular graft (1) according to any of the previous claims, wherein the thickness of the piezoelectric element (19) of the pressure sensing device (5) and/or the thickness of the piezoelectric element (19) of the velocity sensing device (7) perpendicular to the main extension plane is 2 to 20 pm, preferably 4 pm.
17. The vascular graft (1) according to any of the claims 5 or 11, wherein the flexible layer (23) of the pressure sensing device (5) comprises polyamide, PI, and/or the flexible layer (23) of the velocity sensing device (7) comprises polyamide, PI.
18. The vascular graft (1) according to any of the claims 5 to 17, wherein the thickness of the flexible layer (23) of the pressure sensing device (5) and/or the thickness of the flexible layer (23) of the velocity sensing device (7) perpendicular to the main extension plane is 2 to 25 pm, preferably 8 pm.
19. The vascular graft (1) according to any of the previous claims, wherein each pressure sensing device (5) and each velocity sensing device (7) are arranged on the first side of the substrate (3) such that, in the rolled-up configuration, the pressure sensing and velocity sensing devices (5, 7) are arranged along a line, preferably with a distance between the devices along the line of 1 to 10 mm, particularly preferred 5 mm, wherein the line extends along an axial direction (31) of the substrate (3) and is parallel to the axis around which the substrate is rolled up in the rolled-up configuration.
20. The vascular graft (1) according to any of the previous claims, wherein the vascular graft (1) further comprises electrically conductive paths (9), wherein each of the paths (9) is coupled with one end to one of the elements comprising the first electrode (17) of the pressure sensing device (5), the second electrode (21) of the pressure sensing device (5), the first electrode (17) of the velocity sensing device (7), and the second electrode (21) of the velocity sensing device (7), wherein each of the paths (9) extends in a meandering shape from the respective first end to a respective second end.
21. The vascular graft (1) according to any of the previous claims, preferably according to claim 20, wherein the vascular graft (1) further comprises a flexible encapsulation layer, which is arranged on the first side of the substrate (3) such that, in the rolled-up configuration, the flexible encapsulation layer is arranged radially inward of each of the pressure sensing devices (5), each of the velocity sensing devices (7), and/or each of the electrically conductive paths (9).
22. The vascular graft (1) according to claim 21, wherein the encapsulation layer comprises parylene, preferably a chlorinated parylene, particularly preferred parylene C.
23. The vascular graft (1) according to any of the claims 21 or 22, wherein the thickness of the encapsulation layer perpendicular to the main extension plane is 1 to 10 pm, preferably 5 pm.
24. Vascular graft system comprising a vascular graft (1) according to any of the previous claims and a flexible processing unit configured to be attachable to a skin and configured to process signals received from the vascular graft (i).
